other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands
Beneficiary must be a girl child or woman
Birth incentive eligibility requires birth on or after 01‑10‑2013
Girl children born before the scheme implementation but under 13 years and not covered under the Planned Family Scheme are eligible only for educational incentives
Funds cannot be withdrawn before the beneficiary turns 18 years old
Benefits are discontinued if the parent or beneficiary provides false information
No benefits are given if the child gets married before the age of 21
If the child becomes a school dropout, only education‑related benefits may be provided
In case of death before the disbursal age, the amount may be released to the parents
benefits_summary: Cash incentives are provided at birth, on passing the VIII, X and XII standards, and on marriage at ages 21 and after 25.
